name: FMC Philippines 2025
information: ### **Welcome to the first ever WCA Fewest Moves simultaneous competition in the Philippines!** This isn't your typical speed solving competition as **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for non-FMC competitions near your area [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=PH). --- ### Locations See [Location tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCPhilippines2025#56448-locations) for more details. --- *Additional locations may be added until 14 days before the competition starts, so stay tuned for updates!*
